map.CV 为什么用均值除？: Why does CV divide by the mean?
map.CV 会失真甚至发散，此时不宜用 CV，改用绝对离散度指标。: CV distorts or even diverges when the mean is near zero, so do not use CV there; switch to an absolute dispersion index.
map.CV=σ/μ×100%，无量纲比较离散度。: CV=σ/μ×100%, a dimensionless comparison of dispersion.
map.→ 打开由均值与标准差求变异系数工具: -> Open the coefficient of variation from mean and standard deviation tool
map.不同量纲或均值差异大的数据可比性。: Comparability across data with different dimensions or widely differing means.
map.均值接近 0 时？: What if the mean is close to 0?
map.标准差有量纲，除以均值消去量纲，使不同单位（身高 cm vs 重量 kg）的离散: Standard deviation is dimensioned, so dividing by the mean removes the dimension, letting dispersion across units (height in cm vs weight in kg) be compared side by side.
map.由均值与标准差求变异系数 使用指南: Coefficient of variation from mean and standard deviation user guide
map.由相关系数求决定系数: Coefficient of determination from the correlation coefficient
map.输入均值 μ 与标准差 σ，按 CV = σ/μ × 100% 计算变异系数，用: Enter mean μ and standard deviation σ and compute CV = σ/μ × 100% to compare dispersion and relative fluctuation across data of different dimensions.
map.：A 组 μ=100、σ=15 → CV=15%；B 组 μ=50、σ=12 →: : group A μ=100, σ=15 → CV=15%; group B μ=50, σ=12 → CV=24%. B fluctuates more relatively even though σ is smaller.
map.：基金年化收益 8%、σ=12% → CV=150%；低收益高波动需谨慎。: : fund annualised return 8%, σ=12% → CV=150%; low return with high volatility needs caution.
